title: Making an Enemy have the same stats and stuff of an Actor

posts.author: supah
posts.body: In my RPG Maker MV game, I plan on making some actors fightable, as well as a doppelganger of the protagonist. I plan on having their stats and skills and such be the same as their actor variants. How do I do this?

posts.author: Maliki79
posts.body:
I want to EVENTUALLY implement this in my game, so I'll weigh in:
I have no idea.
I do know that along with the skills, and equipment, you will need to program the enemy to work with the skills available.
Might not be as difficult as I imagine it will, but depending on the the complexity of your game, it might be VERY hard to code things.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
while you can easily use script calls to forcibly change an enemy's base parameters during runtime, skills are another matter. enemies have to be told what skills they have and *when* to user them, which is done through the skill patterns and ratings.
do you allow the players change actor classes or are otherwise unable to just set the enemy Harold to have all the skills Harold and his class has?
